inference.scene_on: sample_motion(..., use_scene=True): retain all learned static/dynamic, patch, local-query and learned-feedback paths.
inference.scene_off: sample_motion(..., use_scene=False): disable the complete learned scene path; do not merely zero occupancy.

scene_budget.observation_budget: entire supplied recording observed-static union; same observer/world/split only; dynamics current frame
scene_budget.coordinate_protocol: persistent world map; transform to current window anchor at query

pairing: Within a mode, use exactly the same window, body profile, camera, observations, missingness masks, reference, observation noise and DDIM seed in ON/OFF. Do not change adapters or observation anchors.
scene_ablation_interpretation: Inference removal of all learned scene context from one fixed model; not a retrained no-scene baseline or isolated cross-attention ablation. Observation visibility masks remain fixed.

evaluation_scope.VAL: Full eligible indexed validation windows requested; write actual coverage and exclusions before reporting completion.
evaluation_scope.TEST: RICH TEST main benchmark remains a separate frozen evaluation; never use TEST results to select/tune weights.
evaluation_scope.case_manifests_seeds_and_execution: Draft scope only; no long evaluation or new training is authorized/launched by this record. Model selection and evaluation plan remain under discussion.
evaluation_scope.reporting: Report all three datasets separately, recording-level aggregates and window aggregates, valid counts, full/visible/missing-joint and temporal/foot metrics. Different EGO/EXO eligible cohorts must not be silently conflated.

existing_results_reuse: Old official41k RICH TEST used different weights and analytical physics ON, so it is a baseline only. Control EGO arrays may be reused only when checkpoint-equivalent path, inputs, seeds and inference settings match exactly.
